message: Performance Update + Money Maker Skin is here!
patchNotes: 🗺️ NEW: Epic Map – dynamic day/night sky with stars, clouds, and city silhouette
💎 NEW: Money Maker now as a Skin (1000 Coins) – 2x Coins + Shield every run + golden particles
⚡ PERFORMANCE: Game now runs at the same speed on all devices, capped at 120 FPS
🔐 FIX: Login button now responds instantly with loading feedback (no double-tap needed)
🎨 Ground now features grass details and improved gradient
🐛 Bug Fix: Shield stays permanently active with Money Maker
